description: §6.13.5 (S479): a `throttled=1s` engine cell. Click #load: the leading write commits at once (Idle -> Loading). Click #finish inside the window: held. Advance the window: the trailing commit is judged against the variant the cell holds THEN (Loading, which admits .Done), so the engine reaches Done. XFAIL on impl#1: it parses neither the §66 `single` engine opener nor a timed engine (S471 policy: impl#1 is frozen; carried gap g-impl1-timed-engine-commit-s479).
rationale: §6.13.5: "`rule=` (§51.0.F) is judged at the commit, against the variant the cell holds then"; §6.13.2: "The first write in any window emits immediately; subsequent writes within `DURATION` of the last emit are suppressed but the most recent suppressed value is held. At the end of the window a single trailing write emits with the held value." ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S479 "⭐ RULED — the rest of S478 hand-off §3.B, PA recs adopted" item 8.
